definitions.levels: causal fractal (k=2) pivots on 1d (250-day lookback) and 4h (180-bar lookback), confirmed k bars later, clustered within 0.25·ATR(1d)
definitions.reach: any 15m bar within 0.10·ATR(4h) of the level inside the horizon
definitions.bounce: ≥0.50·ATR(4h) away from the level within 4×15m bars of the first touch with no 15m close beyond by >0.10·ATR
definitions.break: a 15m close beyond the level by >0.10·ATR(4h) within those bars
definitions.trend4h: last two confirmed 4h swing highs and lows (HH+HL / LH+LL)
definitions.fib: level within 0.15·ATR(1d) of a retracement/extension of the last confirmed daily swing (fibZones.fib)
definitions.gann: level within 0.15·ATR(1d) of a Square-of-9 level anchored on the last confirmed daily swing high/low (gannSquare9)
definitions.volume: 15m volume on the touch bar vs the prior-20-bar mean
